purpose: Smallest discriminating matrix for the ten measured gray cells that sit between both resolved phase colors in the crossing-free slope-flow map.

branches.hypothesis: The beta sign is stable across size subsets but unresolved because five seed trajectories do not determine it precisely enough.
branches.action: Add five independent 200-shot trajectories at every existing distance, doubling the seed-cluster count from five to ten.

branches.hypothesis: The three-distance beta sign is unstable because the LER scaling has size-window curvature that same-distance shots cannot resolve.
branches.action: Add a matched L=11,13 pair with five independent 200-shot trajectories; L=11 anchors the new cohort and L=13 extends the scaling window.

inference.primary_statistic: beta in logit(P_logical) = alpha + beta log(L)
inference.cluster_policy: Resample complete seed trajectories independently by distance; never treat shots as independent bootstrap clusters.
inference.seed_limited_analysis: Pool only source-compatible old and new seed clusters at L=7,9,11, then refit beta. Promotion requires the central 90% interval to exclude zero, sign probability at least 0.95, and all leave-one-distance-out signs to agree.
inference.distance_limited_analysis: Use the new matched L11/L13 cohort to test the large-distance direction, then fit source-compatible L=7,9,11,13 counts. Promotion requires the four-distance beta interval to exclude zero, sign probability at least 0.95, all four leave-one-distance-out signs to agree, and the new L11/L13 sign to agree with beta.
inference.failure_policy: Any cell missing a gate remains gray; no neighboring cell, contour, p_c, or q_c is inferred from it.

provenance_policy: Every new shard must pass syndrome fidelity, gzip row-count and SHA-256 integrity, accelerated-runtime verification, and start/end source-hash equality. Pooling with Phase 2 is allowed only when the complete source hash set and decoder configuration match.
stop_rule: Stop after these ten cells and 24000 new decodes. Do not add p or q midpoints, unrestricted L15, square-lattice cells, or a phase boundary without a new registered decision.
launch_gate: Execution and preregistered analysis are complete. All ten jobs and 24000 rows passed the completion audit. Slope-flow gates resolved one target as undecodable and left nine unresolved; the updated map contains 81 green, 37 red, and 113 gray cells. Evidence: results/phase-s1-honeycomb-slope-flow-gray-frontier-analysis-2026-08-28.json. The dispatcher will not relaunch an analyzed manifest.
